title: Laamu henndu e yiite
intro: Natal laamu ɗo henndu nduu e hoore mum jaabotoo laamɗo gooto, ɗo daande tagooje ɓurɗe famɗude ɗee njogii teddeendi, ɗo doole ɗe gite gaadoraaɗe njiyataa ina mbaɗee e nder golle tiiɗɗe. Ooɗoo limoore roni laamu keewngu e giɗo mum, jogiiɗo doole e dow tagopeeje e jinneeji. Kono laamu mawngu arii e jarribooji mawɗi — e sahaa cakkitiiɗo oo, maa feeñnin huunde haawniinde e sifaa nguurndam e maayde e hoore mum.
clues: Mi ronii laamu mawngu e jibinannde am giɗaaɗo kadi ko annabi e maccuɗo Alla.
Alla rokkii kam laamu e dow henndu, neldi ɗum e golle lewru e nder subaka gooto.
Hay tagooje ɓurɗe famɗude ina kaala haala am, miɗo joofna miɗo haawaa e anniyaaji maɓɓe.
Mi yamirii konu mawngu jinneeji, yimɓe e colli, fof ina njuɓɓinaa e laylayti renndo yeeso am.
Laamɗo woɗɗuɗo ari jarribaade mi e caɗeele caɗtuɗe, miɗo yamiri yo oon jappeere laamɗo adde e suudu am hade njillu nguu ummoraade e jooɗorde.
Miɗo heddii miɗo darii, miɗo tuugnii e sawru, haa tagoore tokosere leydi ndii ɓuuɓtii nde — ko ndeen tan wonɓe e sara am ɓee nganndi mi rewii.

arabic: وَلِسُلَيْمَـٰنَ ٱلرِّيحَ عَاصِفَةًۭ تَجْرِى بِأَمْرِهِۦٓ إِلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ ٱلَّتِى بَـٰرَكْنَا فِيهَا ۚ وَكُنَّا بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَـٰلِمِينَ
verse: And to Solomon [We subjected] the wind, blowing forcefully, proceeding by his command toward the land which We had blessed. And We are ever, of all things, Knowing. (21:81)
